text:
What azar

Sweet parecido to a dream azar

Us reunió here in this land distant

Here two souls extrañas nosotros

Were unidos for the Musa

That us llevó of viaje

Nuestras souls convirtiéndose in a song

Flotando in a air of Mozart

In your precioso world

You dijiste: What profundos your eyes

What sweet are

Lo dijiste with a silent, resonante desire

Already that no estábamos solos

And in your eyes a invitación

And in my profundidades intoxicación

What intoxicación

Am a woman thus that discúlpale to my heart your vanidad

When your murmullo lo acaricia: What profundos your eyes

What sweet are


Oh Poet, in my country

My amado country

Tengo a enamorado esperando

Él is my compatriota no I have of derrochar

Your heart

Él is my compatriota no I will sell

Your love

For the tesoros of the world

For the brillantes stars

For the Moon

Without embargo the intoxicación aferra my heart

While in your eyes derivan sombras of love

And the invitación centellea

As a light trémula


Am a woman of modo that perdónale to my heart your vanidad

When your murmullo lo acaricia: What profundos your eyes

What sweet are.

translation.title: No I will sell this love
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
